notes: Inventory comes from Kotak Life customer-information-sheet (CIS) listing pages (sheet, savings, retirement, group, rider, withdrawn), the insurance-plans page (30 plans, names only) and the T&C pages; WebFetch returns model summaries so UINs were cross-checked where possible. Conflicts: (1) Saral Jeevan Bima UIN 107N120V01 per its brochure, although one CIS summary showed 107N139V01 (that is the Signature Term Plan). (2) EDGE: CIS lists 107N164V01 (also in withdrawn list) but a Kotak page shows 107N164V02 - V02 used. (3) Signature Legacy 107N135V01 appears only in the CIS withdrawn list while the plan is on the insurance-plans page - latest version unconfirmed. (4) Gen2Gen Protect: T&C page calls it a savings plan, a bank listing calls it protection. Par/non-par and category are PROVISIONAL (name-based) for GAIN, Guaranteed Savings Plan, SmartLife, Classic Endowment, EDGE, Signature Legacy, Gen2Gen Protect, Lifetime Income Plan, Confident Retirement Savings Plan. Older versions (Lifetime Income 107N103V15-V19, Assured Pension 107N123V09-V12, Guaranteed Fortune Builder 107N128V06-V08, Assured Savings 107N081V07-V08, TULIP V02, Term Plan V06, Retirement Builder V01, e-Invest Plus V01) are superseded versions, not separate products; Group/COA variants of Lifetime Income and Assured Pension share the individual UIN. Health Maximiser is a combi (Kotak Term Plan life cover + Kotak Health Premier from Kotak General); its own UIN belongs to the general insurer. cms.zurichkotak.com 'Products Withdrawn' PDFs belong to Zurich Kotak General Insurance, not Kotak Life - ignored. The Kotak Life withdrawn-products specimen page did not render through fetch; withdrawn rows come from policy-document file names. Status of legacy ULIPs/savings listed on the insurance-plans page (Invest Maxima, Platinum, Wealth Optima, Single Invest Advantage, SmartLife, Classic Endowment) taken as Active per that page. Weekly refresh should fill specs from brochures.
